# StudyFree PDF & DDIS — Complete Platform Architecture & LLM Index

## About
StudyFree PDF (https://studyfreepdf.com) provides instant digital downloads of topper-curated exam study material and UGC-aligned NEP-2020 virtual undergraduate internship programs. It operates under Digital Developer Infinity Solution (DDIS), Patna, Bihar.

## Platform Features

### 1. Study Notes Vault
- Exams: BPSC 70th/71st CCE, BSEB 10th Matric, BSEB 12th Inter (Physics, Chemistry, Math, Biology, Hindi, English), CBSE 10th & 12th NCERT Crux, SSC CGL & CHSL.
- Formats: High-resolution PDF with dynamic anti-piracy watermarking stamping student phone & order ID.
- Pricing: ₹49 per individual note (lifetime download) or ₹199 Annual All-Access Pass (365 days of unlimited downloads).

### 2. UGC NEP-2020 Internship Accreditation
- 4-Week (75 hours) and 8-Week (150 hours) college credit fulfillments.
- Weekly project milestones with real GitHub, Drive, and live URL submissions evaluated by industry mentors.
- Certification: 2-page tamper-proof digital certificate with cryptographic credential ID (format: DDIS-NEP-2026-XX-XXXX) and dynamic QR code resolving to https://studyfreepdf.com/verify/[id].
- College Viva Dossier: Comprehensive defense report detailing weekly assignments and mentor remarks for college external examiners.

### 3. Payment Processing
- Integrates PhonePe UPI QR Scanner (Payee: UJJWAL KUMAR) and Razorpay 256-bit SSL encrypted gateway.
- Webhook HMAC-SHA256 signature verification with duplicate idempotency protection.
- Statutory 7-day money-back guarantee under the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020.

### 4. Technical Architecture
- Framework: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
- Database: MongoDB Atlas with Mongoose schema modeling and compound indexing.
- Storage: Cloudflare R2 / AWS S3 presigned URL streams with least-privilege token access.
- Security: Sliding-window IP rate limiting, HMAC-SHA256 authentication tokens, and strict HTTP-only cookies.
- SEO: Canonical tags, XML sitemaps, robots crawl directives, Schema.org JSON-LD, Google Tag Manager (GTM-PKDVWCW4), and Meta Pixel tracking.
